title: Counting, start to finish
idea: Review-leaning finale. Recap len(), len-1 for last position, empty check, range(len(...)). Interleaves indexing and loops.

options: How many items the list has
exercises.explanation: len is the item count — the heart of this unit.

exercises.prompt: Recap: for a list of len N, the last valid position is...
exercises.explanation: Positions run 0 to N-1, so the last is N - 1. This is the bridge between len and indexing.
len(n) is 4 (first line). The last item is n[4 - 1] = n[3] = 16 (second line).

exercises.prompt:
Recap the empty check. Predict:

box = []
print(len(box) == 0)
exercises.explanation: An empty list has len 0, and 0 == 0 is True. len == 0 is the 'is it empty?' guard.

exercises.prompt:
Predict:

n = [5, 10, 15]
for i in range(len(n)):
    print(n[i])
exercises.explanation: len(n) is 3, so i is 0, 1, 2 and n[i] prints 5, 10, 15. range(len(n)) walks every position.

exercises.prompt: Recap: range(len(list)) produces exactly the valid positions of the list.
exercises.explanation: len gives the count; range turns it into 0, 1, ..., count-1 — every real position, no more.

exercises.prompt: Match each list to its len.
exercises.explanation: Count the items, numbers or words, repeats included. Empty is 0.

exercises.prompt:
Review a counter from Lap 3. Predict:

total = 0
for i in range(3):
    total = total + 1
print(total)
exercises.explanation: The loop runs 3 times, adding 1 each time, so total is 3. Interesting: that's the same as len of a 3-item list — counting by looping and counting with len agree.

exercises.prompt: Goal: print how many items, then print the last item. Arrange the lines.
exercises.explanation: len(marks) is 4 (printed first), and marks[4 - 1] = marks[3] = 100 (the last item).

exercises.prompt: You can make, index, and count a list. What's the next list power the course adds?
options: Adding new items and changing existing ones
exercises.explanation: Next comes growing and changing a list — adding items and replacing values. Nicely done mastering len!
